info.name: Adrash API (Stage 1)
info.description:
## አድራሽ (Adrash) — Stage 1 API

Ethiopian intercity passenger transport platform. This collection covers every endpoint exposed by `Adrash.API` on the `feature/bus-classification-route-pricing` branch.

### Conventions
- **Base URL**: `{{baseUrl}}` (defaults to `http://localhost:5000/api/v1`)
- **Auth**: JWT Bearer via collection-level auth (`Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`).
- **Response envelope**: `{ success, data, errors, meta }`.
- **Enums** travel as strings (e.g. `"Approved"`, not `2`).
- **Money**: ETB only, `decimal(18,2)`.
- **Timestamps**: ISO 8601 UTC.

### Quick start
1. Hit `Auth › OTP › Send` with your phone.
2. In Dev, the OTP is logged to the API console. Run `Auth › OTP › Verify` — the test script auto-stores `accessToken` + `refreshToken`.
3. Every subsequent request inherits the Bearer token automatically.

### Roles & permissions
Endpoints are protected by **policy** (`Admin`, `Driver`) and **fine-grained permissions** (e.g. `DriversApprove`, `PaymentsManualConfirm`). The bootstrap config seeds `+251911032089` as SuperAdmin in non-Production environments — that account can hit anything.

### Variables
- `baseUrl` — API base, includes `/api/v1`
- `accessToken` / `refreshToken` — auto-populated by Auth requests
- `tripId`, `bookingId`, `routeId`, `driverId`, `busId`, `transactionId`, `pickupLocationId`, `stopId`, `documentId`, `passengerId`, `roleId`, `agreementVersion`, `deviceToken` — set these as you go for easy chaining.

exec: // no-op: per-request prerequest hooks live on the request itself.

item.name: Auth
item.description: OTP-only authentication. Once the OTP is verified, the test script automatically writes `accessToken`, `refreshToken`, and `deviceToken` to the collection variables.

request.description:
Generates a 6-digit OTP, stores a BCrypt hash, and dispatches via AfroSMS (mocked → console log in Development).

**Rate limit**: 3 sends per phone per 15 minutes.

**Body**
- `phone` (string, required) — E.164 format, e.g. `+251911032089`.

exec: console.warn('OTP verify did not return tokens; response:', JSON.stringify(res));

request.description:
Verifies the OTP, issues an access + refresh token pair, and (optionally) provisions a trusted device.

**Body**
- `phone` (string, required)
- `code` (string, required) — 6-digit OTP
- `existingDeviceToken` (string, optional) — pass an existing device token to refresh trust
- `deviceLabel` (string, optional) — human-readable device name
- `deviceFingerprint` (string, optional)

**Response highlights**: `tokens.accessToken`, `tokens.refreshToken`, `isNewUser`, `needsSetup`, `agreementRequired`. The test script auto-stores tokens.

One-time setup right after a freshly verified user. Sets `FullName` and optionally promotes from Passenger → Driver.

**Body**
- `firstName` (required, ≤100)
- `lastName` (required, ≤100)
- `role` (optional) — `"Passenger"` or `"Driver"`. Admin accounts are never provisioned here.

Returns a fresh token pair if the role changed.
Sign in with PIN + previously trusted device token. 5 failed attempts → 30 min lockout. Admin accounts must re-verify via OTP every 30 days regardless of PIN.
Create or change PIN. `currentPin` required only when changing an existing PIN.
Returns the caller's non-revoked trusted devices.
Revoke a single trusted device. `:id` is the device's GUID.
Revoke every trusted device for the caller and invalidate all refresh tokens. Forces a fresh OTP login next time.
Rotates refresh tokens. The old token is revoked, a new pair is issued. Absolute max session age: 90 days.
Revokes the supplied refresh token. Returns 204.

Records immutable acceptance of the given agreement version with IP + UA fingerprinting.

**`agreementType`**: `Passenger` | `Driver`.
Returns the currently active agreement document — version, multi-language content, effective date.
Returns the authenticated user's profile (id, phone, full name, role, preferredLanguage).

Update name and/or preferred language. Phone changes require a separate OTP re-verification flow.

**`preferredLanguage`**: `En` | `Am` | `Om`.
Soft-deletes the authenticated passenger account. Blocks if any active booking exists.

item.name: Drivers (self-service)
item.description: Endpoints for drivers managing their own profile, documents, vehicle and trips. Most require `Policy = Driver`.

request.description: Creates a User (role=Driver) plus an Incomplete DriverProfile. Returns access + refresh tokens — driver should run OTP-verify first, since AfroSMS may also be required for OTP.

Updates the driver's personal details. Driver must be ≥18.

**`gender`**: `Unspecified` | `Male` | `Female` | `Other`.
Create or update the driver's vehicle. `isOwner=true` forces an `OwnershipProof` document on profile submit.

Configure where payouts land.

- `method = BankTransfer` → requires `bankHolderName`, `bankName`, `bankAccountNumber`.
- `method = MobileWallet` → requires `walletProvider` (`Telebirr` | `CBEBirr` | `HelloCash` | `ADC`) and `walletPhoneOrRef`.

Sensitive fields are encrypted at rest (AES-256).

formdata.description: NationalId | DriverLicence | Roadworthiness | Insurance | PoliceClearance | OwnershipProof

request.description: Streams the file directly to S3. Magic-byte validation enforced. Returns presigned URL (1h TTL).
Upload a single vehicle photo into one of 4 fixed slots. Replacing an existing slot overwrites.
Clear a vehicle photo slot. `:slot` ∈ `Front | Rear | Interior | Dashboard`.
Validates all required sections are complete (personal + vehicle + 5 documents + payout) and flips status `Incomplete → Pending`. 422 with missing-sections list if any gap remains.
Full driver profile with documents (presigned URLs), payout prefs (masked), and completion %.
Lightweight status check: `{ status, rejectionReason?, completionPct, missingSections[] }`.
Returns the authenticated driver's `upcoming`, `inProgress`, `completed`, and `cancelled` trips.
Driver-initiated trip scheduling (uses the driver's currently-assigned bus). `destinationGeofenceRadiusMetres` valid range: 50–5000.
Driver can cancel their own scheduled trip. Triggers full refunds + AfroSMS notifications to confirmed passengers.

item.name: Routes
item.description: Routes and their nested pickup locations. Read endpoints are public. Mutating endpoints require `Policy=Admin` + `RoutesManage` permission.

request.description: Paginated list of routes.
Full route detail: polyline, stops (ordered), pickup locations.
Create a route. ≥2 stops required, sequence orders must be unique and strictly increasing. Distance 0–10000 km, duration 0–1440 min.
Full update — same body as create.
Soft-deactivate: sets `is_active = false`. Existing trips remain.
All active pickup points for a route, ordered by `sequenceOrder`.

item.name: Buses
item.description: All bus endpoints require `Policy=Admin` and the `BusesManage` permission.

request.description: **`type`**: `MiniBus` | `Isuzu` | `PrivateCar`.
Records the assignment in bus_assignment_history. Driver must be Approved.

item.name: Trips
item.description: Trip lifecycle: schedule → start → location pings → check in passengers → end (geofenced).

request.description: Drivers see their own trips. Admins see all. Filters: status, routeId, driverId, date range.
Driver/Admin: includes passenger manifest. Passenger: only sees trip info, not manifest.
Public — used by the booking flow. Cached in Redis 30s. Returns `[{ seatNumber, isBooked }]`.
Validates: driver Approved, bus Active, no time conflict for either.
Only allowed while status = Scheduled.
Admin cancels a trip. Triggers full refunds and SMS to all confirmed passengers.
Driver-only. Departure_time must be within ±30 min. Flips status → InProgress.
Geofenced — must be inside `destinationGeofenceRadiusMetres` of final dropoff stop. Outside → 400 `Trip.OutsideGeofence`.
Bypasses geofence. Creates a `trip_incident` with admin_override fields. Required when an incident is recorded but driver couldn't reach the dropoff.
Records `actual_arrival` on the trip_stop. Triggers `BUS_ARRIVED_PICKUP` SMS to passengers boarding at this stop.
Verify the HMAC-signed QR payload. Returns passenger name, seat #, pickup name, status.
**`type`**: `FlatTyre` | `Mechanical` | `Accident` | `Delay` | `Other`.
Appended to trip_location_logs and broadcast to the `trip-{tripId}` SignalR group. Server also emits `GeofenceStatus` to the driver. Note: prefer the SignalR hub `SendLocation` for live trips.
Passenger manifest: seat, name, phone (masked), pickup, dropoff, boarding state.

Creates a booking holding the seats with a Redis pessimistic lock (10-min TTL).

**Rules**:
- `seatNumbers.length == passengerDetails.length`
- `pickupLocationId` must belong to the trip's route
- `dropoffStopId` must be downstream of pickup
- `pointsToRedeem` ≤ passenger balance and ≥ min_redemption if > 0
- Passenger may hold ≤2 Pending bookings at a time
Passenger sees own bookings. Admin sees all.
Passenger cancels own; admin cancels any (admin = full refund regardless of policy). If points were redeemed, they're refunded too.

Starts a payment for a Pending booking. Only the last 4 chars of `accountRef` are persisted (masked). Returns `transactionId`, `gatewayRef`, provider instructions, expiry.

**`method`** currently supports: `ADC` (other Ethiopian mobile-money providers wired but pending sandbox credentials).
Manual re-check of a still-Pending transaction. Calls the provider's verify API.

Provider-to-server callback. `:method` in URL = `telebirr` | `cbebirr` | `hellocash` | `adc`. Signature is validated via constant-time comparison; 401 on mismatch.

On `Success` the booking is confirmed and a BOOKING_CONFIRMED SMS goes out.
Returns providers configured + currently enabled in this environment.

Audit-logged manual confirmation when the provider has actually received the money but the webhook never arrived. Requires `PaymentsManualConfirm` permission. Cannot run on a terminal-state transaction.
Replace `:id` with a payout GUID.
Returns `{ pointsBalance, etbEquivalent }` using the currently active redemption rate.
Reduces the booking total by the rewards-config redemption rate. Reversed automatically on booking cancellation.
**`channel`**: `InApp` | `Sms`. `eventType` is a free-form string identifying the event.
Allowed only when booking belongs to caller and is Completed. One review per booking. `score` ∈ 1..5.

item.name: Admin / Drivers
item.description: Driver moderation. Requires `Policy=Admin` + permissions such as `DriversView`, `DriversApprove`, `DriversSuspend`.

request.description: Full profile with documents (1h presigned URLs) and payout prefs (masked).
Status → Approved. Sends DRIVER_APPROVED SMS.
**`category`**: `Disruptive` | `NoShow` | `Harassment` | `PropertyDamage` | `PaymentDispute`.

item.name: Admin / Reports
item.description: All require `Policy=Admin` + `ReportsView`. Uses the read replica.

request.description: Snapshot KPIs for the admin home page: trips today, active trips, revenue today, pending drivers, payouts today, stuck transactions.
Two-sided commission. Both percentages 0–100. **Rate is snapshotted on the payout at trip completion**, so changing it does not affect already-completed trips.
**`percentIncrement`** range: -90 to 500, must not be 0. To remove, delete the row.
Default radius used when scheduling trips. Per-trip overrides also allowed. Valid range: 50–5000.

request.description:
**`target`**: `AllPassengers` | `AllDrivers` | `Route` | `SingleDriver` (last two require `targetId`).
**`channel`**: `Sms` | `InApp` | `Both`.

SMS goes out in each recipient's preferred language.
All permissions grouped by category, ready for a role-editor UI.

item.name: Admin / Admin users
item.description: Manage admin accounts (`UsersManage` permission required throughout).

request.description: Tells you whether this phone is already a user — and, if so, whether inviting them as admin would promote an existing Passenger/Driver. Use the `confirmPromotion=true` flag on invite when this returns a hit.
Creates the admin or promotes an existing user. If the phone already maps to a non-Admin user, the request will require `confirmPromotion=true`.

item.name: Agent / Drivers (sales-agent flow)
item.description: Sales agents register drivers in person. Requires `DriversAgentRegister` permission.

request.description: Agent enters the OTP they helped the driver receive on their phone. Creates the User + Incomplete DriverProfile.
Same validation as the driver-self-service submit endpoint.
